# Audit: Priority-law semantic matrix

Generated from `src/state/priorityLaws.js` and `docs/spec/audit/signoff-manifest.json`.
Each priority law has one behaviour test (law on vs. law off on the same fixture, so a gated
law is distinguished from a broken one) and one boundary test, both in
[`tests/unit/priorityLawSemantics.test.js`](../../../tests/unit/priorityLawSemantics.test.js) under the names
`<LAW> (<family>) > behaviour: …` and `<LAW> (<family>) > boundary: …`.

Priority laws: **18**, all with a sign-off record.

| Law | Family | Behaviour test | Boundary test | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GRAV | force | pulls a two-body pair together; gated off it does nothing | stays finite for coincident particles | `priority-law-grav` (operational) |
| CHARGE_LAW | force | opposite charges approach, like charges separate | neutral particles feel no force | `priority-law-charge-law` (operational) |
| DRAG | force | reduces speed monotonically | never reverses velocity direction | `priority-law-drag` (operational) |
| ELECTRIC_FIELD | force | drifts polarised particles along the field | leaves unpolarised particles unaccelerated | `priority-law-electric-field` (operational) |
| LIFE | lifecycle | metabolism advances hunger and a starving particle dies | never touches a dead particle | `priority-law-life` (operational) |
| REPRO | lifecycle | mature, driven particles produce offspring | immature particles (age < 100) never reproduce | `priority-law-repro` (operational) |
| SENESCENCE | lifecycle | old particles die over time | young particles (age ≤ 500) never die of age | `priority-law-senescence` (operational) |
| ENERGY | lifecycle | equalises energy between neighbours and conserves the total | equal-energy neighbours exchange nothing | `priority-law-energy` (operational) |
| COLL | structural | separates overlapping particles | keeps speeds finite and bounded | `priority-law-coll` (operational) |
| CONTACT | structural | pushes overlapping particles apart | leaves well-separated particles untouched | `priority-law-contact` (operational) |
| BOND | structural | forms reciprocal bonds between near neighbours | never bonds a particle to itself or duplicates a partner | `priority-law-bond` (operational) |
| MEMORY | information | accumulates memory in particles | keeps memory finite and non-negative | `priority-law-memory` (operational) |
| SIGNAL_BOOST | information | relays signal from a signalling particle to a neighbour | silent particles (signal ≤ 0.01) relay nothing and signal stays ≤ 1 | `priority-law-signal-boost` (operational) |
| LEARN | information | aligns neighbour velocities | leaves already-aligned particles aligned | `priority-law-learn` (operational) |
| SUPERPOSITION | quantum | prepares superposed amplitudes | amplitudes stay finite and within [0, 1] | `priority-law-superposition` (proxy) |
| WAVE_PARTICLE | quantum | a measured particle decays back to wave mode | an unmeasured isolated particle stays in wave mode | `priority-law-wave-particle` (proxy) |
| ENTANGLEMENT | quantum | entangles neighbours with reciprocal links | isolated particles stay free | `priority-law-entanglement` (proxy) |
| OBSERVER | quantum | with WAVE_PARTICLE, high-memory observers measure neighbours | low-memory observers measure nothing | `priority-law-observer` (proxy) |
